svg.title: MotoWorks dark admin products dashboard with view, edit, and undo states
svg.desc: A dark products dashboard with a read-only product details dialog in front of an edit form, and a delete undo notification.

g.text: Manage your catalog, pricing, and stock levels.
Search products by name or SKU
Organic dark roast coffee beans, carefully sourced
and freshly roasted for a rich, smooth finish.
Delete action will be final if Undo is not selected.
